image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a tabby cat's face and upper chest. The cat has brown and black striped fur with white markings on the muzzle and chest. It is licking its nose with a pink tongue. A blue collar or tag is visible at the bottom. The background is out of focus, appearing to be white fabric.

The blue object (likely a collar tag) has an ambiguous geometry. It seems to merge into the fur without a clear attachment point or strap, and its shape is irregular and poorly defined.
